_about: Configuration for the v4 category page (oria-v4/oria-practice-v2.php, 'The Wellness Horizon'). Stands in for category-level ACF fields until those exist (they belong to the oria-core plugin). focal: CSS object-position for the hero photograph, per category slug (a sub-category falls back to its parent's). moods: the 'Ways to begin' chooser; each mood lists SERVICE taxonomy slugs, and the template drops any the page's own listings do not carry, then any mood left with none. A mood has no URL of its own: choosing one ticks those services in the page's filter engine (svc=...). note: the in-results 'Oria Note' copy. Copy here must stay descriptive: no health or outcome claims.
